elements.motion: In the ruined limestone colonnade, the three suspended bronze bells rock gently by a few pixels in the highland breeze, swinging slightly left and right from their fixed iron chains and settling smoothly back to rest. Preserve their weathered olive-brown bronze patina and carved rims with no change in colour or brightness. Keep the white limestone arches, fluted columns, shadows, and yellow flowers beneath completely still.
elements.why: Brings the namesake Cloudbell Cloister colonnade bells gently to life.

elements.motion: On the right-hand ruined column, a soft breeze ripples down the hanging slate-blue pennant banner from its fixed wooden rod to its forked lower tip. The pale gold leaf emblem bends naturally with a shallow slow wave in the cloth before settling back. Keep the rod attachment, fluted limestone pillar, climbing ivy, and meadow grass completely still.
elements.why: Adds unmistakable wind motion to the signature cloister banner inside the safe area.

elements.motion: Across the wide sunlit green-and-gold plateau meadow, a slow highland breeze sweeps gently from left to right through the painted grass tufts, tiny white daisies, and golden clover patches. Each grassy clump bends a few pixels eastward and springs quietly back with no white wind streaks, no colour shift, and no new objects. Keep the pale sunken flagstones, mossy stone fragments, and darker ground tones steady.
elements.why: Animates the large open central-north plateau meadow visible on both desktop and phone.

elements.motion: On the sunlit grassy terrace west of the road, the painted yellow wildflower clusters and olive-green grass blades lean gently eastward a few pixels in a passing breeze and ease back together. Keep the brushwork soft and unchanged with zero pale streaks or flashes. Hold the cracked limestone cliff edge, fallen column capital, and rocky ground perfectly still.
elements.why: Lifts the quiet western meadow between the cliff rim and the main path.

elements.motion: Around the ruined northeast limestone aqueduct, a gentle breeze stirs the leafy olive-green shrubs, trailing ivy vines draped along the upper stone arches, and golden-yellow wildflowers along the cliff base. The soft painted leaf clusters sway together by a few pixels and recover smoothly without growing new branches or sharpening outlines. Keep the pale limestone arches, squared stone blocks, and distant clouds completely rigid.
elements.why: Animates the greenery and wildflowers framing the northeast aqueduct landmark.

elements.motion: Along the eastern cliffside meadow, the warm yellow-green grass blades and clusters of golden wildflowers near the rim bend softly a few pixels in the breeze and spring back smoothly. Keep the sunlit brushwork and muted palette intact with no wind lines or brightness shifts. Hold the pale limestone cliff rim, stone rubble, and distant sky behind it perfectly still.
elements.why: Adds gentle meadow motion across the open eastern plateau near the castle.

elements.motion: In the open sky beyond the southeast cliff edge, the existing soft cream and pale lavender cloud mist drifts very slowly right by a few pixels and eases back seamlessly. Keep every cloud edge diffuse and painterly with zero hard outlines, zero curls or spirals, and no brightening. Hold the limestone cliff face, dark floating rock islet, and grassy rim in front completely sharp and stationary.
elements.why: Restores gentle cloud drift behind the southeast sky-island cliff without ornamental spirals.
